_doc: Prompts for `hdart ai-kit`: every part is an edit of the base mannequin (see hdart/ai_kit.py). Write what to ADD; the tool appends 'keep the same character, pose, framing... change nothing else'. Colours in prompts only guide the shapes and shading: parts are recoloured from the palette ramps afterwards. Optional per part: seed, lora (pixel LoRA strength for the edit, default 0.6).

face.neutral.prompt: Give the character large anime eyes with a calm neutral expression

face.kind.prompt: Give the character large anime eyes and a warm gentle smile

face.stern.prompt: Give the character narrowed eyes, furrowed brows and a stern frown

face.wide.prompt: Give the character very large round surprised anime eyes and a small open mouth

hair.short.prompt: Give the character short messy brown hair with a fringe

hair.long.prompt: Give the character long flowing silver hair with a fringe, reaching the waist

hair.ponytail.prompt: Give the character red hair tied in a high ponytail with a fringe

hair.spiky.prompt: Give the character short spiky dark brown hair

hair.bun.prompt: Give the character black hair tied in a neat bun with a fringe

hair.mohawk.prompt: Give the character a tall green mohawk, sides shaved

hair.braid.prompt: give her a thick single braid down her left shoulder, with a fringe at the end.

facial.beard.prompt: Give the character a full thick brown beard

facial.mustache.prompt: Give the character a curled brown mustache

head.hood.prompt: Put a green cloth hood with a short shoulder mantle on the character

head.helmet.prompt: Put a steel knight helmet with an open face and a nose guard on the character

head.wizard_hat.prompt: Put a tall pointed purple wizard hat with a bent tip and a gold band on the character

head.cap.prompt: Put a brown leather cap with a feather on the character

head.circlet.prompt: Put a thin gold circlet with a small blue gem on the character's forehead

torso.tunic.prompt: Dress the character in a red tunic with gold trim, short sleeves, a leather belt with a pouch

torso.robe.prompt: Dress the character in a long blue mage robe with white trim, wide sleeves and a sash, covering the legs

torso.plate.prompt: Dress the character in steel plate armour with layered shoulder pauldrons and a tabard

torso.vest.prompt: Dress the character in a white shirt with rolled sleeves and a laced brown leather vest

torso.coat.prompt: Dress the character in a long dark green travelling coat with brass buttons and a high collar

legs.shorts.prompt: Give the character dark blue shorts

legs.greaves.prompt: Give the character steel leg greaves

feet.boots.prompt: Give the character brown leather boots with folded cuffs

feet.shoes.prompt: Give the character simple brown leather shoes

hands.gloves.prompt: Give the character brown leather gloves

back.cape.prompt: Give the character a long red cape hanging behind them, fastened at the shoulders

back.quiver.prompt: Give the character a leather quiver full of arrows on their back

mainhand.sword.prompt: Put a steel sword in the character's right hand, held point up

mainhand.staff.prompt: Put a tall wooden staff with a glowing blue crystal on top in the character's right hand

mainhand.dagger.prompt: Put a small dagger in the character's right hand

mainhand.mace.prompt: Put a spiked steel mace in the character's right hand

offhand.shield.prompt: Put a round wooden shield with a steel rim and boss on the character's left arm

offhand.tome.prompt: Put a thick leather-bound spell book in the character's left hand

offhand.lantern.prompt: Put a small glowing brass lantern in the character's left hand
